artifacts.delta_brief: Between 2022 and 2023, NVDA continues to emphasize supply_chain and security as core risk exposure (2022 para 38; 2023 para 112). The earlier filing is relatively more anchored in supply_chain, while the later filing adds clearer weight to security (2022 para 129; 2023 para 195). Across both years, management frames these items as operational and financial execution pressures rather than isolated one-off events (2022 para 38; 2023 para 195). This comparison should be read as directional because the lens is a focuspack subset and not the full Item 1A text (2022 para 129; 2023 para 112). Overall, the narrative indicates continuity with selective shifts in emphasis instead of a full thematic reset (2022 para 38; 2023 para 112).
